description: This file defines the interface for network operations in the Wesnoth game, including connection management, data transmission, and statistics.

classes.name: network::server_manager
classes.description: Handles server-side listening on a port.

classes.name: network::connection_stats
classes.description: Stores statistics for a network connection.

methods.name: network::manager
methods.description: Constructor for network manager, initializes threading.

methods.name: network::server_manager
methods.description: Constructor for server manager, starts listening on port.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a remote host.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a specific or all connections.

methods.name: queue_disconnect
methods.description: Queues a disconnection for later processing.

methods.name: set_default_send_size
methods.description: Sets maximum bytes to send at once.

methods.name: send_data
methods.description: Sends or queues data to a connection.

methods.name: send_data_all_except
methods.description: Sends data to all except one connection.

methods.name: ip_address
methods.description: Retrieves IP address of a connection.

methods.name: get_send_stats
methods.description: Gets send statistics for a connection.

methods.name: get_receive_stats
methods.description: Gets receive statistics for a connection.
